content:
No such certificate is presently known: a valid example would refute the Jacobian conjecture in dimension \(3\).

Moreover, the supplied reference map does not have constant Jacobian determinant. At \((0,0,0)\),
\[
J_F(0,0,0)=
\begin{pmatrix}
0&0&1\\
0&1&0\\
2&0&0
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\det J_F(0,0,0)=-2,
\]
whereas at \((1,0,0)\),
\[
J_F(1,0,0)=
\begin{pmatrix}
0&0&1\\
1&1&3\\
2&-3&-1
\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\det J_F(1,0,0)=-5.
\]
Thus the reference map does not satisfy \(\det J_F\in\mathbb C^\times\), so it establishes no degree-\(7\) counterexample.
